slice.objective: Audit whether an already-connected Chat-native message/email or other server-record mutation can provide a non-user-controlled server timestamp plus immutable or independently retained record, without new plugin installation, secret disclosure, manual user action, finite monthly/trial/paid quota, incremental cost, or a mutation outside the role-local repository write boundary.
slice.method: Capability-contract and official-public-document audit only. No Gmail, Calendar, recipient, or other external-account mutation was performed because cross_field writes are authorized only in its role-local repository namespaces and no external-recipient semantics were pre-authorized.

public_sources.observation: Gmail Message id is immutable; internalDate is the internal message creation timestamp and for normal SMTP-received mail reflects the time accepted by Google.
Drafts can be created, updated/replaced, sent, and immediately/permanently deleted.
Calendar Event created is a read-only RFC3339 creation timestamp, but events support update and delete.
Calendar can server-generate an event id when the client omits one; attendee copies require adding attendees and can trigger notifications.
OpenTimestamps can later independently verify existence-before-time using Bitcoin attestations; public calendar servers are advertised as free and requiring no registration or API key.

slice.conflict_check: Only cross_field role-local repository state/receipt namespaces are eligible for mutation. Gmail/Calendar/private data and recipient side effects were not consumed or mutated.

frontier: Gmail improves server-timestamp separation but independent retention requires a distinct recipient copy; that route is not safe or authorized without explicit recipient semantics and would violate this role's write boundary.
Calendar provides a read-only creation timestamp but not immutable independent retention because the user-owned event can be modified or deleted.
OpenTimestamps remains the strongest independence benchmark but no role-authorized scheduled-Chat mutation surface to its calendar servers is established.
